findings.title: 80-bed recovery center closes at Massillon health hub after 8 months
findings.exact_supporting_passage: It shut its doors on Oct. 16 due to apparent medical reimbursement shortfalls.
findings.service_line: inpatient/residential substance use disorder treatment and addiction recovery
findings.access_consequences: An 80-bed addiction recovery facility operated by Ohio Valley Physicians Health at the Massillon Community Health & Innovation Center, 870 Amherst Road NE, reportedly stopped operating on October 16, 2026. This is a newly discovered same-day published recall, not an event occurring in the present hourly window. Further confirmation of patient transfers and operator statement is unavailable.
findings.affected_population: Patients seeking residential addiction recovery treatment in Massillon/Stark County and surrounding areas; number of occupied beds or transferred patients unknown.
